Subject: POC hands-on: three-zone demo runbook & session cadence

Hi Alex —

Thanks for agreeing to a hands-on POC. To make the sessions productive for your engineers and security reviewers, we propose a focused 3-session cadence spanning US / EU / APAC-friendly windows (rotate time-of-day so teams in each region get at least one overlap). Attached is a lightweight runbook (POC-runbook-v1.pdf) and a draft load-test plan.

High-level proposal (all times in UTC with local equivalents):
- Option A — Morning US / Late EU / Overnight APAC
  - 15:00 UTC (US morning, EU late afternoon, APAC late night) — 90m
- Option B — Evening US / Morning APAC / Late EU
  - 00:00 UTC (US evening, APAC morning, EU late night) — 90m
- Option C — Midday EU / Evening APAC / Early US
  - 11:00 UTC (EU midday, APAC evening, US early morning) — 90m

Agenda for each session (90m):
1) 10m introductions & scope
2) 30m prompt walkthrough & routing demo (prompt sets attached)
3) 30m live load test / throughput rehearsal (we'll exercise batching & KV-cache behavior)
4) 10m failure/fallback and security Q&A
5) 10m next steps / rollouts

Please pick two preferred options and any hard constraints for your security or infra folks. If you need, we can compress the load-test portion and follow up with recorded traces.

Action items for us: Grace will own the prompt run-through; Dev will run the load test plan and confirm endpoints; Ben will coordinate calendar invites and region-specific invites.

Attachments: POC-runbook-v1.pdf, loadtest-plan.xlsx, calendar-invite.ics

Thanks — looking forward to locking times.

—Priyom
